title: "Progressive ILD RBC Chemical Shift"
format: html
editor: visual
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(tidymodels)
library(openintro)
library(janitor)
```

```{r}
#Read In CSVs
"007s_data" <- read_csv("/Users/anuraganugu/Documents/spectroscopy_combined_007s.csv")
"009s_data" <- read_csv("/Users/anuraganugu/Documents/spectroscopy_combined_009s.csv")
```

```{r}
#Remove the S1s and S2s from the csv that are incorrect
`007s_data_filtered` <- `007s_data` |>
  slice(-c(78, 80, 81, 83))
```

```{r}
#Filter out S2 scans
`007s_data_filtered` <- `007s_data_filtered`|>
  filter(!grepl("s2", subject_id, ignore.case = TRUE))
```

```{r}
#Remove string S1
`007s_data_filtered` <- `007s_data_filtered` |>
  mutate(subject_id = str_remove(subject_id, "_s1"), subject_id = str_remove(subject_id, "_S1"))
```

```{r}
#Remove subjects that are part of the control group
`007s_data_filtered` <- `007s_data_filtered` |>
  slice(-c(1, 2, 14, 15, 16, 17, 32, 33, 34, 35, 73, 74, 75, 81, 82, 83, 84, 93, 94, 95, 96, 97, 98, 99, 100, 104))
```

```{r}
#Remove outlier with abnormal RBC shift or that don't have GX scan
`009s_data_filtered` <- `009s_data` |>
  slice(-c(173, 202))
```

```{r}
#Combine dataframes
combined_spect_data <- bind_rows(`007s_data_filtered`, `009s_data_filtered`)
```

```{r}
#Create Timepoint and Subject Variable
combined_spect_data_transformed <- combined_spect_data |>
  mutate(
    timepoint = case_when(
      str_detect(subject_id, "A$") ~ "3 Months",
      str_detect(subject_id, "B$") ~ "6 Months",
      str_detect(subject_id, "C$") ~ "12 Months",
      TRUE ~ "Baseline"
    ),
    timepoint = factor(
      timepoint,
      levels = c("Baseline", "3 Months", "6 Months", "12 Months")
    )
  ) |>
  relocate(timepoint, .after = 1) |>
  mutate(subject = str_remove(subject_id, "[ABC]$")) |>
  relocate(subject, .after = 1) 
```

```{r}
#Summary Statistics
combined_spect_data_transformed |>
  group_by(timepoint) |>
  summarize(
    n = n(),
    mean = mean(rbc_shift, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd = sd(rbc_shift, na.rm = TRUE),
    median = median(rbc_shift, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
```

```{r}
#Make side-by-side boxplots
ggplot(combined_spect_data_transformed, aes(timepoint, rbc_shift)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.15, alpha = 0.5) +
  labs(
    x = "Timepoint",
    y = "RBC Shift",
    title = "RBC Shift Across Treatment Timepoints"
  ) +
  theme_bw()
```

```{r}
#Make dataset needed for analysis between just baseline and 3 months
combined_spect_data_b_and_3m <- combined_spect_data_transformed |>
  filter(timepoint %in% c("Baseline", "3 Months")) |>
  group_by(subject) |>
  filter(all(c("Baseline", "3 Months") %in% timepoint)) |>
  ungroup()
```

```{r}
#Make spaghetti plot for baseline and 3 months
ggplot(combined_spect_data_b_and_3m,
       aes(x = timepoint,
           y = rbc_shift,
           group = subject)) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.2) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(
    title = "RBC Shift: Baseline vs 3 Months",
    x = "",
    y = "RBC Shift"
  )
```

```{r}
#Pivot dataset wider
b_and_3m_wide <- combined_spect_data_b_and_3m |>
  select(subject, timepoint, rbc_shift) |>
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols = subject,
    names_from = timepoint,
    values_from = rbc_shift
  )
```

```{r}
#Create new variable called delta rbc shift (3 months-baseline)
b_and_3m_wide <- b_and_3m_wide |>
  mutate(
    delta_rbc_shift = `3 Months` - Baseline
  )
```

```{r}
#Get summary statistics for the delta_rbc
b_and_3m_wide|>
  select(delta_rbc_shift) |>
  summarize(
    n = n(),
    mean = mean(delta_rbc_shift, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd = sd(delta_rbc_shift, na.rm = TRUE),
    median = median(delta_rbc_shift, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
```

```{r}
#Create histogram for the delta
ggplot(b_and_3m_wide, aes(x = delta_rbc_shift)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 10) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of Delta RBC Shift",
    x = "Delta RBC Shift",
  )
```

```{r}
#Create Q-Q plot to see if it follows a normal distribution
qqnorm(b_and_3m_wide$delta_rbc_shift)
qqline(b_and_3m_wide$delta_rbc_shift)
```

```{r}
#paired t-test where average change is comparaed to 0
t.test(b_and_3m_wide$delta_rbc_shift, mu = 0)
```

```{r}
rcv_calculations_filled <- read_csv('/Users/anuraganugu/Documents/Relative Capillary Volume Calculations Filled.csv')
```


```{r}
#Create relative capillary volume calculation with method 1 (GLI)
vc_method_1 <- rcv_calculations_filled |> 
  filter(age <= 80) |>
  mutate(ref_rbc_mean = case_when(
    xe_dissolved_offset_frequency == 218 ~ 0.0049,
    xe_dissolved_offset_frequency == 208 ~ 0.0048,
    TRUE ~ NA_real_
  )) |>
  mutate(relative_vc = alveolar_volume * rbc_mean / gli_va / ref_rbc_mean) |>
  filter(!is.na(relative_vc)) |>
  mutate(
    timepoint = case_when(
      str_detect(subject_id, "A$") ~ "3 Months",
      str_detect(subject_id, "B$") ~ "6 Months",
      str_detect(subject_id, "C$") ~ "12 Months",
      TRUE ~ "Baseline"
    ),
    timepoint = factor(
      timepoint,
      levels = c("Baseline", "3 Months", "6 Months", "12 Months")
    )
  ) |>
  relocate(timepoint, .after = 1) |>
  mutate(subject = str_remove(subject_id, "[ABC]$")) |>
  relocate(subject, .after = 1) 
```

```{r}
#Summary Statistics
vc_method_1 |>
  group_by(timepoint) |>
  summarize(
    n = n(),
    mean = mean(relative_vc, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd = sd(relative_vc, na.rm = TRUE),
    median = median(relative_vc, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
```

```{r}
#Make side-by-side boxplots
ggplot(vc_method_1, aes(timepoint, relative_vc)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.15, alpha = 0.5) +
  labs(
    x = "Timepoint",
    y = "Relative VC",
    title = "Relative VC Across Treatment Timepoints"
  ) +
  theme_bw()
```

```{r}
#Read In CSV for tyvaso abbreviated
"tyvaso_abbreviated" <-read_csv("/Users/anuraganugu/Documents/tyvaso_subjects_abbreviated.csv")
```

```{r}
#Create tyvaso relative capillary volume calculation with method 1 (GLI)
tyvaso_abbreviated_vc <- tyvaso_abbreviated |> 
  filter(age <= 80) |>
  mutate(ref_rbc_mean = case_when(
    xe_dissolved_offset_frequency == 218 ~ 0.0049,
    xe_dissolved_offset_frequency == 208 ~ 0.0048,
    TRUE ~ NA_real_
  )) |>
  mutate(relative_vc = alveolar_volume * rbc_mean / gli_va / ref_rbc_mean) |>
  filter(!is.na(relative_vc)) |>
  mutate(
    timepoint = case_when(
      str_detect(subject_id, "s1") ~ "Baseline",
      str_detect(subject_id, "s2") ~ "15 Min",
      str_detect(subject_id, "s3") ~ "3 Hours",
    ),
    timepoint = factor(
      timepoint,
      levels = c("Baseline", "15 Min", "3 Hours")
    )
  ) |>
  relocate(timepoint, .after = 1) |>
  mutate(subject = sub("_s[123]$", "", subject_id)) |>
  relocate(subject, .after = 1) 
```


```{r}
#relative vc method 2 calculations
vc_both_methods <- vc_method_1 |>
  mutate(
    vc_over_VA_ref = 15.4 -
      0.972 * (sex == "M") -
      0.0391 * age -
      0.000352 * age^2, 
    vc_method_2 = vc_over_VA_ref * alveolar_volume * rbc_mean / ref_rbc_mean, ref_vc_method_2 = if_else(
      sex == "M",
      -23.8 + 0.645 * height - 0.00547 * age^2,
      -13.8 + 0.527 * height - 0.00421 * age^2
    ),
    relative_vc_method_2 = vc_method_2/ ref_vc_method_2)
```

```{r}
# Create Bland-Altman data
ba_data <- vc_both_methods %>%
  mutate(
    mean = (relative_vc + relative_vc_method_2) / 2,
    diff = relative_vc_method_2 - relative_vc
  )

# Calculate bias and limits of agreement
bias <- mean(ba_data$diff, na.rm = TRUE)
sd_diff <- sd(ba_data$diff, na.rm = TRUE)

upper_loa <- bias + 1.96 * sd_diff
lower_loa <- bias - 1.96 * sd_diff

# Plot
ggplot(ba_data, aes(x = mean, y = diff)) +
  geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = bias,
             color = "blue",
             linewidth = 1) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = upper_loa,
             color = "red",
             linetype = "dashed",
             linewidth = 1) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = lower_loa,
             color = "red",
             linetype = "dashed",
             linewidth = 1) +
  labs(
    title = "Bland–Altman Plot",
    x = "Mean of Relative VC Measurements",
    y = "Difference (Munkholm - GLI)"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14)
```

```{r}
#Create Scatterplot
ggplot(vc_both_methods,
       aes(x = relative_vc,
           y = relative_vc_method_2)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  coord_equal() +
  labs(x = "Relative VC GLI",
       y = "Relative VC Munkholm",
       title = "GLI vs Munkholm Relative VC Methods")
```

```{r}
#Correlation statistics for the methods
cor.test(
  vc_both_methods$relative_vc,
  vc_both_methods$relative_vc_method_2
)
```

```{r}
#read in csv for tyvaso 99th percentile normalization
tyvaso_99 <- read_csv("/Users/anuraganugu/Documents/tyvaso_gx_99th_percentile.csv")
```

```{r}
#calculate VC using our new method and create timepoints for the subjects
tyvaso_99_vc <- tyvaso_99 |>
  filter(!subject_id %in% c(
    "006-107_s3",
    "006-108_s1",
    "006-108_s3"
  )) |>
  mutate(ref_rbc_mean = case_when(
    xe_dissolved_offset_frequency == 218 ~ 0.0049,
    xe_dissolved_offset_frequency == 208 ~ 0.0048,
    TRUE ~ NA_real_
  )) |>
  mutate(relative_vc = alveolar_volume * rbc_mean / 5.614594 / ref_rbc_mean) |>
  filter(!is.na(relative_vc)) |>
  mutate(
    timepoint = case_when(
      str_detect(subject_id, "s1") ~ "Baseline",
      str_detect(subject_id, "s2") ~ "15 Min",
      str_detect(subject_id, "s3") ~ "3 Hours",
    ),
    timepoint = factor(
      timepoint,
      levels = c("Baseline", "15 Min", "3 Hours")
    )
  ) |>
  relocate(timepoint, .after = 1) |>
  mutate(subject = sub("_s[123]$", "", subject_id)) |>
  relocate(subject, .after = 1) 
```

```{r}
#get summary statistics
tyvaso_99_vc |> 
  summarise(
    vdp_mean = mean(vent_defect_pct, na.rm = TRUE),
    vdp_sd   = sd(vent_defect_pct, na.rm = TRUE),
    rbc_mean_mean         = mean(rbc_mean, na.rm = TRUE),
    rbc_mean_sd           = sd(rbc_mean, na.rm = TRUE),
    relative_vc_mean         = mean(relative_vc, na.rm = TRUE),
    relative_vc_sd           = sd(relative_vc, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
```


```{r}

    "006-108_s3_ma"
  )) |>
  mutate(ref_rbc_mean = case_when(
    xe_dissolved_offset_frequency == 218 ~ 0.0049,
    xe_dissolved_offset_frequency == 208 ~ 0.0048,
    TRUE ~ NA_real_
  )) |>
  mutate(relative_vc = alveolar_volume * rbc_mean / 5.614594 / ref_rbc_mean) |>
  filter(!is.na(relative_vc)) |>
  mutate(
    timepoint = case_when(
      str_detect(subject_id, "s1") ~ "Baseline",
      str_detect(subject_id, "s2") ~ "15 Min",
      str_detect(subject_id, "s3") ~ "3 Hours",
    ),
    timepoint = factor(
      timepoint,
      levels = c("Baseline", "15 Min", "3 Hours")
    )
  ) |>
  relocate(timepoint, .after = 1) |>
  mutate(subject = sub("_s[123]_ma", "", subject_id)) |>
  relocate(subject, .after = 1) 
```

```{r}
#get summary statistics
tyvaso_ma_vc |> 
  summarise(
    vdp_mean = mean(vent_defect_pct, na.rm = TRUE),
    vdp_sd   = sd(vent_defect_pct, na.rm = TRUE),
    rbc_mean_mean         = mean(rbc_mean, na.rm = TRUE),
    rbc_mean_sd           = sd(rbc_mean, na.rm = TRUE),
    relative_vc_mean         = mean(relative_vc, na.rm = TRUE),
    relative_vc_sd           = sd(relative_vc, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
```

```{r}
#Make spaghetti plot for timepoints and relative vc
ggplot(tyvaso_ma_vc,
       aes(x = timepoint,
           y = relative_vc,
           group = subject,
           color = subject)) +
  geom_line(alpha = 1) +
  geom_point(alpha = 1) +
  stat_summary(
    aes(group = 1),
    fun = mean,
    geom = "line",
    color = "black",
    linewidth = 1.5
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 0.9)) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(
    title = "Tyvaso Relative VC Timepoints (Mean Anchor)",
    x = "",
    y = "Relative VC"
  )
```

```{r}
#Plot global variables
ggplot(tyvaso_ma_vc, aes(x = rbc_shift, y = relative_vc)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "red") +
  labs(
    x = "RBC Shift",
    y = "Relative VC",
    title = "Relationship Between RBC Shift and Relative VC (Mean Anchor)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 0.9)) 
```

```{r}
#Get correlation coefficient
cor.test(
  tyvaso_ma_vc$rbc_shift,
  tyvaso_ma_vc$relative_vc
)
```
